studioBindings.basis: A native TSIR cycle activates these illustrative assemblies together. Studio supplies its driver and cycle interval.

name: QCCD reference installation
note: The bench, chassis, chamber, carrier and cables are an illustrative lab installation. Route lengths are drawn lengths. Program timing determines signal arrival. The chip uses the H2 electrode span and isthmus width. Its surface faces up here. The imported H2 wells follow Studio geometry. The broadcast program places its own independent lanes inside the same reference envelope. Beads, collimated light rays and indicator lights are display markers.

chipModel.basis: Moses et al. Figs. 1 and 2 and Sec. II.A supply the H2 span, width, pitch and ion-surface separation. Studio provides H2 site positions in pitch units. Broadcast lane spacing, marker size and within-site display separation are illustrative.
